meta.review_notes: Strict re-analysis: camera/microphone, contacts/phonebook, storage/file access, and health/biometric marked unknown because the privacy policy is silent on these categories. Developer corrected to GTHW App Limited per policy text. Policy URL updated to get-headway.com. Terms URL not found in policy.

app.name: Headway: Fun & Easy Growth
app.description: A daily micro-learning app offering 15-minute book summaries, audio learning, and personalized reading goals to help users grow through bite-sized content.

verdict.one_liner: Headway tracks reading habits and shares data with over 20 advertising partners.
verdict.summary: Headway collects your name, email, reading preferences, and extensive device data including IP address, hardware ID, and advertising identifiers. It shares this data with over 20 third-party companies including Facebook, Google, TikTok, and Snapchat for advertising and analytics. The privacy policy does not clearly explain whether the app accesses your camera, contacts, local files, or health data.
verdict.recommendation_reason: Headway extensively tracks your behavior and shares your data with many advertising and analytics companies. The privacy policy is also silent on several common permission categories, which raises questions about what else the app may access.

red.title: Data shared with over 20 advertising and analytics companies
red.plain_english: Headway shares your data with Facebook, Google, TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, Appsflyer, Amplitude, Firebase, and many other companies. Some of your data is stored and processed on their servers.

red.title: Reading habits tracked to target ads
red.plain_english: Headway analyzes what you read, how long you read, and your reading goals. It states that it and its partners, including Facebook and Google, use your personal data to tailor ads.

red.title: Detailed device fingerprint collected
red.plain_english: Headway automatically collects your device model, operating system, language, IP address, hardware ID, mobile carrier, and advertising identifiers such as IDFA and AAID.

red.title: IP address and activity logs shared with partners
red.plain_english: Headway collects your IP address and activity logs automatically and shares them with advertising partners and analytics providers.

red.title: Profiles users for marketing under 'legitimate interest'
red.plain_english: Headway claims it may rely on 'legitimate interest' to analyze your behavior and send you marketing communications. It also claims 'legitimate interest' to personalize ads.

red.title: Terms and Conditions URL not clearly provided
red.plain_english: The privacy policy references Terms and Conditions of Use but does not provide a direct link to them.

green.title: Explicitly states it does not sell personal information
green.plain_english: Under California privacy law, Headway states it does not sell your personal information and has no knowledge of selling data from minors under 16.

green.title: Payment card details never stored by the app
green.plain_english: All payments are processed by third parties like Apple, Stripe, and PayPal. Headway says it will not store or collect your payment card details itself.

green.title: Account deletion available in the app
green.plain_english: You can delete your account using the Settings menu in the app or by contacting support. The process may take up to 30 days.

green.title: Detailed opt-out instructions for personalized ads
green.plain_english: Headway provides step-by-step instructions for iOS, Android, macOS, Windows, and web browsers on how to opt out of personalized advertising.

green.title: Regional privacy rights for EEA, CA, VA, and NV residents
green.plain_english: Depending on where you live, you may have additional rights including data portability, the right to complain to a regulator, or the right to opt out of targeted advertising.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not say whether Headway uses your camera or microphone.
categories.detail: The privacy policy makes no mention of camera or microphone access. Because the policy is silent, we cannot confirm whether this permission is requested.
concerns: Policy is silent on camera and microphone access

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: Headway's California privacy disclosure lists geolocation data as a category collected, but the policy does not clearly explain whether this means precise GPS or just a general area from your IP address.
categories.detail: The CCPA supplemental notice lists 'Geolocation data' as a category of personal information collected and disclosed to service providers and advertising partners. The main policy does not explicitly describe GPS or precise location collection for core service delivery.
categories.policy_excerpt: Geolocation data ... Service providers ... Advertising partners
concerns: Geolocation data listed under CCPA categories but precision unclear

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not say whether Headway accesses your contacts or phonebook.
categories.detail: The privacy policy makes no mention of contacts, address book, or phonebook access. Because the policy is silent, we cannot confirm whether this permission is requested.
concerns: Policy is silent on contacts and phonebook access

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not say whether Headway accesses your device files or photo library.
categories.detail: The privacy policy does not mention storage or file access permissions. Because the policy is silent, we cannot confirm whether this permission is requested.
concerns: Policy is silent on storage and file access

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Headway shares your data with over 20 companies including Facebook, Google, TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, and analytics providers. Some of your data is stored and processed on their servers.
categories.detail: Data is shared with a very extensive list of third parties: mobile app marketplaces, cloud storage providers, data analytics providers, measurement partners, marketing partners, payment processors, and communication services providers. The policy explicitly states they do not sell personal information under CCPA.
categories.policy_excerpt: we may process data using solutions developed by Facebook, Google, Twitter, Appsflyer, Amplitude, Firebase, Snapchat, Pinterest, Apple, Digital Ocean, Vercel, Customer.io, Zendesk, PayPal, Stripe, Microsoft, Tableau, TikTok
concerns: Very extensive list of third-party data recipients
Data stored and processed on third-party servers
Marketing and advertising partners receive personal data

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Headway requires your name, email, and reading preferences. It also collects device identifiers, advertising IDs, hardware ID, and IP address, which are shared with ad partners.
categories.detail: Account creation requires name, email, and reading preferences. Data collected automatically includes: device language, IP address, time zone, device type and model, device settings, operating system, Internet service provider, mobile carrier, hardware ID, IDFA, and AAID. This data is used for service delivery, analytics, and advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: We will ask you to enter information about your reading preferences, name, email. We also automatically collect from your device language settings, IP address, time zone, type and model of a device, device settings, operating system, Internet service provider, mobile carrier, hardware ID, and other unique identifiers (such as IDFA and AAID).
concerns: Advertising identifiers collected and shared with ad partners
Hardware ID collected for device tracking
IP address linked to user identity

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Headway tracks how you use the app and shares this information with Facebook, Google, and many other partners to show you personalized ads.
categories.detail: The app uses extensive behavioral tracking for advertising. They analyze interactions including subscription frequency, reading goals, and time spent reading. Personalized ads are served through Facebook, Google, Twitter, TikTok, Snapchat, Pinterest, and Microsoft. They use device identifiers and activity data for ad targeting. Opt-out instructions are provided.
categories.policy_excerpt: We and our partners, including Facebook and Google, use your personal data to tailor ads and possibly even show them to you at the relevant time.
concerns: Extensive ad tracking with 10+ advertising partners
Behavioral profiling for ad measurement under 'legitimate interest'
Reading habits used for ad targeting

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Headway says it is not meant for users under 16 and does not knowingly collect data from children. It does not clearly explain how it verifies age.
categories.detail: The app states it does not knowingly process personal data from persons under 16 years of age. Users under 16 are instructed not to use the Services. There is no explicit age verification mechanism at sign-up.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not knowingly process personal data from persons under 16 years of age.
concerns: No age verification mechanism at sign-up
Relies on self-attestation and post-hoc discovery

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Headway logs your IP address and activity continuously. This data is shared with analytics and advertising partners.
categories.detail: IP address and activity logs are collected automatically and continuously. Internet activity data is shared with service providers and advertising partners. The app uses reCAPTCHA (Google) for website security.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also collect data automatically (for example, your IP address, activity logs) and use third-party service providers for such collection.
concerns: IP address collected and shared with ad partners
Activity logs used for profiling and ad targeting

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Headway collects detailed device information including model, OS, language, carrier, hardware ID, and advertising identifiers to track your device across sessions.
categories.detail: Device information collected includes: device language settings, time zone, device type and model, device settings, operating system, Internet service provider, mobile carrier, hardware ID, IDFA, and AAID. This creates a comprehensive device fingerprint used for service delivery, analytics, profiling, and advertising.
categories.policy_excerpt: We also automatically collect from your device language settings, IP address, time zone, type and model of a device, device settings, operating system, Internet service provider, mobile carrier, hardware ID, and other unique identifiers (such as IDFA and AAID).
concerns: Comprehensive device fingerprint including hardware ID and carrier
Advertising identifiers enable cross-app tracking
Device data shared with 20+ third parties

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not say whether Headway collects health or biometric data.
categories.detail: The privacy policy makes no mention of health, biometric, or medical data collection. Because the policy is silent, we cannot confirm whether this data is requested.
concerns: Policy is silent on health and biometric data

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Headway offers subscriptions through Apple, Google, Stripe, Solidgate, and PayPal. The app says it never stores your payment card details.
categories.detail: The app offers paid subscriptions. Payment processing is handled entirely by third parties. Headway explicitly states it will not store or collect payment card details. Refund requests may require sharing usage data with app stores for verification.
categories.policy_excerpt: We will not store or collect your payment card details ourselves. This information will be provided directly to our third-party payment processors.
concerns: Refund requests may share usage data with app stores

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can delete your account in the app or by contacting support, but it takes up to 30 days. Some data may be kept longer for legal reasons.
categories.detail: Account deletion is available via Settings in the app or by contacting support. The deletion process takes up to 30 days. Once initiated, the account cannot be used and subscription features are lost. Users must cancel subscriptions before deletion. EEA, California, Virginia, and Nevada residents have additional rights.
categories.policy_excerpt: You can delete your account at any time using the functionality found in 'Settings' in the App or the Website, or by contacting us at support@get-headway.com. Upon your request, we will delete your account and all associated data, except for limited information, which will be stored for specific purposes and limited period.
concerns: Deletion takes up to 30 days
Some data retained for legal obligations
Must cancel subscription before deletion to avoid charges

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Headway says it will notify you of material policy changes through the app or other means, but continued use means you accept any changes.
categories.detail: Material changes to the privacy policy will be notified through the Services or by other available means. Users will have an opportunity to review the revised policy. However, continued use after changes become effective constitutes acceptance.
categories.policy_excerpt: If we decide to make material changes to this Privacy Policy, you will be notified through our Services or by other available means and will have an opportunity to review the revised Privacy Policy.
concerns: Continued use constitutes acceptance
